title: Prakrama 4, Sarga 24. The Pastimes in the Circle of Devotees
html:
Gaura in Puri, filled with Radha's mood: His divine madness; Ramananda and Svarupa sing of the rasa-lila; Nityananda comes from Gauda; Gaura and Nityananda speak of the bhakti of Vraja; the names of Krishna and Balarama

Verse 1

ततः श्रीगौराङ्गचन्द्रः स्वरूपाद्यैः समन्वितः।
श्रीराधाभावमाधुर्यैः पूर्णो न वेद किञ्चन॥१॥

tataḥ śrīgaurāṅgacandraḥ svarūpādyaiḥ samanvitaḥ|
śrīrādhābhāvamādhuryaiḥ pūrṇo na veda kiñcana||1||

tatah — then; shri-gauranga-chandrah — Sri Gaurangachandra; svarupa-adyaih — by Svarupa and others; samanvitah — accompanied; shri-radha-bhava-madhuryaih — with the sweetness of Sri Radha's mood; purnah — filled; na veda — knew not; kinchana — anything.

1Then Sri Gaurangachandra, surrounded by Svarupa and others and filled with the sweetness of Sri Radha's mood, was no longer aware of anything else.

Verse 2

रामानन्देन सहितः कृष्णमाधुर्यवैभवम्।
आस्वाद्यास्वादयद्भक्तान् भक्तवश्यः स्वयं हरिः॥२॥

rāmānandena sahitaḥ kṛṣṇamādhuryavaibhavam|
āsvādyāsvādayadbhaktān bhaktavaśyaḥ svayaṁ hariḥ||2||

ramanandena — with Ramananda; sahitah — together; krishna-madhurya-vaibhavam — the splendour of Krishna's sweetness; asvadya — having tasted; asvadayat — made taste; bhaktan — the devotees; bhakta-vashyah — subject to His devotees; svayam — Himself; harih — Hari.

2Together with Ramananda, Hari Himself, who yields to His devotees, tasted the splendour of Krishna's sweetness and gave His devotees to taste it.

Verse 3

वृन्दावनस्मारकाणि वनान्युपवनानि च।
श्रीकृष्णान्वेषणं तत्र यमुनास्मारकेण च॥३॥

vṛndāvanasmārakāṇi vanānyupavanāni ca|
śrīkṛṣṇānveṣaṇaṁ tatra yamunāsmārakeṇa ca||3||

vrindavana-smarakani — recalling Vrindavana; vanani — forests; upavanani — groves; cha — and; shri-krishna-anveshanam — the search for Sri Krishna; tatra — there; yamuna-smarakena — because of what recalled the Yamuna; cha — and.

3The forests and groves that recalled Vrindavana, and His search for Sri Krishna in them; what recalled the Yamuna —

Verse 4

समुद्रपतनञ्चापि स्वरूपाद्यैर्निदर्शितम्।
कृष्णपञ्चगुणेनैव पञ्चेन्द्रियविकर्षणम्॥४॥

samudrapatanañcāpi svarūpādyairnidarśitam|
kṛṣṇapañcaguṇenaiva pañcendriyavikarṣaṇam||4||

samudra-patanam — the fall into the sea; cha api — and also; svarupa-adyaih — by Svarupa and others; nidarshitam — made known; krishna-pancha-gunena — by the five qualities of Krishna; eva — indeed; pancha-indriya-vikarshanam — the drawing of the five senses.

4and His fall into the sea, as Svarupa and others have made known1; His five senses drawn by the five qualities of Krishna2;

Verse 5

सुरभीमध्यपातेन कूर्माकारेण भावनम्।
श्रीरासलीलास्मरणात् प्रलापाद्यनुवर्णनम्॥५॥

surabhīmadhyapātena kūrmākāreṇa bhāvanam|
śrīrāsalīlāsmaraṇāt pralāpādyanuvarṇanam||5||

surabhi-madhya-patena — by falling among the cows; kurma-akarena — in the shape of a tortoise; bhavanam — ecstatic absorption; shri-rasa-lila-smaranat — from remembering the Sri rasa-lila; pralapa-adi-anuvarnanam — the outpourings of ecstatic speech and other descriptions.

5His fall among the cows and His rapture in the shape of a tortoise; the broken speech and the tales born of remembering the Sri rasa-lila;

Verse 6

गोवर्धनभ्रमेणैव चटकगिरिदर्शनम्।
कृष्णाधरामृतास्वादं गोपीभावेन सर्वतः॥६॥

govardhanabhrameṇaiva caṭakagiridarśanam|
kṛṣṇādharāmṛtāsvādaṁ gopībhāvena sarvataḥ||6||

govardhana-bhramena — mistaking it for Govardhana; eva — indeed; chataka-giri-darshanam — the sight of Chataka hill; krishna-adhara-amrita-asvadam — the tasting of the nectar of Krishna's lips; gopi-bhavena — in the mood of the gopis; sarvatah — wholly.

6Chataka hill, seen by Him as Govardhana3; the tasting of the nectar of Krishna's lips, wholly in the mood of the gopis;

Verse 7

मथुरास्मृतिमात्रेण दिव्योन्मादविचेष्टितम्।
जातं स्वयं भगवतो भक्तिप्रेमरसात्मनः॥७॥

mathurāsmṛtimātreṇa divyonmādaviceṣṭitam|
jātaṁ svayaṁ bhagavato bhaktipremarasātmanaḥ||7||

mathura-smriti-matrena — by the mere memory of Mathura; divya-unmada-vicheshtitam — the behaviour of divine madness; jatam — arose; svayam — of Himself; bhagavatah — of Bhagavan; bhakti-prema-rasa-atmanah — whose very self is the rasa of bhakti and prema.

7the divine madness that flared up at the mere thought of Mathura — all this arose in Bhagavan Himself, whose very nature is the rasa of bhakti and prema.

Verse 8

सात्त्विकाद्यैरष्टाभिश्च भावैः सम्पूर्णविग्रहः।
रामानन्दस्वरूपाभ्यां सेवितो राससंज्ञया॥८॥

sāttvikādyairaṣṭābhiśca bhāvaiḥ sampūrṇavigrahaḥ|
rāmānandasvarūpābhyāṁ sevito rāsasaṁjñayā||8||

sattvika-adyaih — sattvika and other; ashtabhih — eight; cha — and; bhavaih — ecstatic transformations; sampurna-vigrahah — His form filled; ramananda-svarupabhyam — by Ramananda and Svarupa; sevitah — served; rasa-samjnaya — with what is called "the Rasa."

8His form was filled with the eight ecstatic transformations, the sattvika and the rest, and Ramananda and Svarupa served Him with what is called "the Rasa"4 —

Verse 9

भावानुरूपश्लोकेन राससंकीर्तनादिना।
श्रीराधाकृष्णयोर्लीलारसविद्यानिदर्शनम्॥९॥

bhāvānurūpaślokena rāsasaṁkīrtanādinā|
śrīrādhākṛṣṇayorlīlārasavidyānidarśanam||9||

bhava-anurupa-shlokena — by a verse befitting His mood; rasa-sankirtana-adina — by singing of the rasa dance and so on; shri-radha-krishnayoh — of Sri Radha and Krishna; lila-rasa-vidya-nidarshanam — the revealing of the knowledge of the rasa of the pastimes.

9with verses befitting His mood, with singing of the rasa-lila and the like, they revealed the knowledge of the rasa of the pastimes of Sri Radha and Krishna.

Verse 10

श्रीराधाशुद्धप्रेम्णा हि श्रवणामृतमद्भुतम्।
पीत्वा निरन्तरं श्रीमच्चैतन्यरसविग्रहः॥१०॥

śrīrādhāśuddhapremṇā hi śravaṇāmṛtamadbhutam|
pītvā nirantaraṁ śrīmaccaitanyarasavigrahaḥ||10||

shri-radha-shuddha-premna — with the pure prema of Sri Radha; hi — indeed; shravana-amritam — nectar for the ears; adbhutam — wondrous; pitva — drinking; nirantaram — unceasingly; shrimach-chaitanya-rasa-vigrahah — Sri Chaitanya, rasa embodied.

10And Sri Chaitanya, rasa embodied, drank that wondrous nectar for the ears unceasingly, with the pure prema of Sri Radha.

Verse 11

सच्चिदानन्दसान्द्रात्मा राधाकान्तोऽपि सर्वदा।
तद्भावभावितानन्दरसमग्नो बभूव ह॥११॥

saccidānandasāndrātmā rādhākānto'pi sarvadā|
tadbhāvabhāvitānandarasamagno babhūva ha||11||

sach-chid-ananda-sandra-atma — whose self is dense being, consciousness and bliss; radha-kantah — the beloved of Radha; api — though; sarvada — always; tad-bhava-bhavita-ananda-rasa-magnah — immersed in the rasa of bliss imbued with Her mood; babhuva — was; ha — indeed.

11He whose nature is dense being, consciousness and bliss, though He Himself is the beloved of Radha, was ever immersed in the rasa of a bliss imbued with Her mood5.

Verse 12

यां यां लीलां प्रकुर्वीत कृष्णः सर्वेश्वरेश्वरः।
तां तां को वक्तुं शक्नोति तत्कृपाभाजनं विना॥१२॥

yāṁ yāṁ līlāṁ prakurvīta kṛṣṇaḥ sarveśvareśvaraḥ|
tāṁ tāṁ ko vaktuṁ śaknoti tatkṛpābhājanaṁ vinā||12||

yam yam — whatever; lilam — pastime; prakurvita — He may perform; krishnah — Krishna; sarva-ishvara-ishvarah — the Lord of all lords; tam tam — that; kah — who; vaktum — to describe; shaknoti — is able; tat-kripa-bhajanam — the recipient of His mercy; vina — except.

12Whatever pastimes Krishna, the Lord of all lords, may perform — who can describe them, unless he has received His mercy?

Verse 13

रामानन्दः स्वरूपश्च परमानन्दनामकः।
काशीश्वरो वासुदेवो गोविन्दाद्याश्च सर्वदा॥१३॥

rāmānandaḥ svarūpaśca paramānandanāmakaḥ|
kāśīśvaro vāsudevo govindādyāśca sarvadā||13||

ramanandah — Ramananda; svarupah — Svarupa; cha — and; paramananda-namakah — the one named Paramananda; kashishvarah — Kashishvara; vasudevah — Vasudeva; govinda-adyah — Govinda and others; cha — and; sarvada — always.

13Ramananda, Svarupa, the one named Paramananda, Kashishvara, Vasudeva6, Govinda and others,

Verse 14

अपरैश्च रसाभिज्ञैः कृष्णसंकीर्तनात्मकैः।
सेव्यमानो रतः कृष्णो भक्तभावविभावितः॥१४॥

aparaiśca rasābhijñaiḥ kṛṣṇasaṁkīrtanātmakaiḥ|
sevyamāno rataḥ kṛṣṇo bhaktabhāvavibhāvitaḥ||14||

aparaih — by others; cha — and; rasa-abhijnaih — connoisseurs of rasa; krishna-sankirtana-atmakaih — wholly given to Krishna's sankirtana; sevyamanah — being served; ratah — took delight; krishnah — Krishna; bhakta-bhava-vibhavitah — imbued with the mood of a devotee.

14and other connoisseurs of rasa, wholly given to Krishna's sankirtana, served Him constantly; and Krishna, imbued with the mood of a devotee, delighted in their service.

Verse 15

श्रीनवद्वीपमासाद्य श्रीनित्यानन्द ईश्वरः।
श्रीचैतन्यरसोन्मत्तस्तन्नामगुणकीर्तनैः॥१५॥

śrīnavadvīpamāsādya śrīnityānanda īśvaraḥ|
śrīcaitanyarasonmattastannāmaguṇakīrtanaiḥ||15||

shri-navadvipam — Sri Navadvipa; asadya — reaching; shri-nityanandah — Sri Nityananda; ishvarah — the Lord; shri-chaitanya-rasa-unmattah — intoxicated with the rasa of Sri Chaitanya; tan-nama-guna-kirtanaih — by chanting His names and qualities.

15Meanwhile Sri Nityananda, the Lord, having reached Sri Navadvipa, intoxicated with the rasa of Sri Chaitanya, sang His names and qualities,

Verse 16

परिपूर्णः सदा भाति गौराङ्गगुणगर्वितः।
तदाज्ञापालनाद्गौडे स्थितोऽपि तत्प्रकाशतः॥१६॥

paripūrṇaḥ sadā bhāti gaurāṅgaguṇagarvitaḥ|
tadājñāpālanādgauḍe sthito'pi tatprakāśataḥ||16||

paripurnah — fulfilled; sada — always; bhati — shines; gauranga-guna-garvitah — proud of Gauranga's qualities; tad-ajna-palanat — by obeying His command; gaude — in Gauda; sthitah — staying; api — though; tat-prakashatah — through His manifestation.

16and He ever shone in fullness, proud of Gauranga's qualities: obeying His command, He stayed in Gauda, yet even there Gaura revealed Himself to Him.

Verse 17

स्वेच्छामयो रसज्ञोऽसौ को वेद तस्य चेष्टितम्।
तद्दर्शनसमुत्कण्ठो ययौ श्रीपुरुषोत्तमम्॥१७॥

svecchāmayo rasajño'sau ko veda tasya ceṣṭitam|
taddarśanasamutkaṇṭho yayau śrīpuruṣottamam||17||

sva-ichchha-mayah — acting by His own will; rasa-jnah — knower of rasa; asau — He; kah — who; veda — knows; tasya — His; cheshtitam — doings; tad-darshana-samutkanthah — longing to see Him; yayau — went; shri-purushottamam — to Sri Purushottama.

17He acts by His own will, He is a knower of rasa: who can fathom His doings? Longing to see Gaura, He set out for Sri Purushottama.

Verse 18

पुष्पवाटीं समासाद्य ध्यायन् गौराङ्गसुन्दरम्।
उत्थाय प्रणमन् भूमौ निपत्य प्रणमन्मुहुः॥१८॥

puṣpavāṭīṁ samāsādya dhyāyan gaurāṅgasundaram|
utthāya praṇaman bhūmau nipatya praṇamanmuhuḥ||18||

pushpa-vatim — the flower garden; samasadya — reaching; dhyayan — meditating on; gauranga-sundaram — beautiful Gauranga; utthaya — rising; pranaman — bowing; bhumau — to the ground; nipatya — falling; pranaman — bowing; muhuh — again and again.

18Coming to the flower garden and meditating on beautiful Gauranga, He rose and bowed, fell to the ground and bowed again and again.

Verse 19

हुङ्कारगम्भीरारावैर्जयगौराङ्गनिःस्वनैः।
तुष्टाव परमप्रीतो गौरचन्द्रं महासुखी॥१९॥

huṅkāragambhīrārāvairjayagaurāṅganiḥsvanaiḥ|
tuṣṭāva paramaprīto gauracandraṁ mahāsukhī||19||

hunkara-gambhira-aravaih — with deep roars of "hum"; jaya-gauranga-nihsvanaih — with cries of "Glory to Gauranga!"; tushtava — praised; parama-pritah — in the highest love; gaurachandram — Gaurachandra; maha-sukhi — in great bliss.

19With deep roars of "hum!" and cries of "Glory to Gauranga!", in the highest love and great bliss, He praised Gaurachandra.

Verse 20

एवं परस्परं कृष्णरामौ हि परमेश्वरौ।
प्रेमभक्तिरसाकृष्टौ चक्रतुरभिवन्दनम्॥२०॥

evaṁ parasparaṁ kṛṣṇarāmau hi parameśvarau|
premabhaktirasākṛṣṭau cakraturabhivandanam||20||

evam — thus; parasparam — each other; krishna-ramau — Krishna and Rama; hi — indeed; parama-ishvarau — the two Supreme Lords; prema-bhakti-rasa-akrishtau — drawn by the rasa of loving devotion; chakratuh — performed; abhivandanam — salutation.

20Thus the two Supreme Lords, Krishna and Rama, drawn by the rasa of loving devotion, greeted each other.

Verse 21

श्रीशचीनन्दनः प्राह श्रीनित्यानन्दमीश्वरम्।
नन्दपुत्र भवान्नन्दगोष्ठभक्तिप्रदः सदा॥२१॥

śrīśacīnandanaḥ prāha śrīnityānandamīśvaram|
nandaputra bhavānnandagoṣṭhabhaktipradaḥ sadā||21||

shri-shachi-nandanah — Sri Shachinandana; praha — said; shri-nityanandam — to Sri Nityananda; ishvaram — the Lord; nanda-putra — O son of Nanda; bhavan — You; nanda-goshtha-bhakti-pradah — the giver of the bhakti of Nanda's cowherd village; sada — always.

21Sri Shachinandana said to Sri Nityananda, the Lord, "Son of Nanda7, You ever bestow the bhakti of Nanda's cowherd village.

Verse 22

अलङ्कारादिरूपेण नवधा भक्तिमुत्तमाम्।
पश्यामि तव देहे च कृष्णकेलिसुखार्णवे॥२२॥

alaṅkārādirūpeṇa navadhā bhaktimuttamām|
paśyāmi tava dehe ca kṛṣṇakelisukhārṇave||22||

alankara-adi-rupena — in the form of ornaments and the like; navadha — ninefold; bhaktim — bhakti; uttamam — supreme; pashyami — I see; tava — Your; dehe — on the body; cha — and; krishna-keli-sukha-arnave — (Your body,) an ocean of the bliss of Krishna's play.

22On Your body — an ocean of the bliss of Krishna's play — I see the supreme ninefold bhakti in the form of ornaments and the like8.

Verse 23

नन्दगोकुलवासिनां भक्तिरेव सुदुर्लभा।
भाव्यते शुद्धभावैश्च लभ्यते वा नरैः क्वचित्॥२३॥

nandagokulavāsināṁ bhaktireva sudurlabhā|
bhāvyate śuddhabhāvaiśca labhyate vā naraiḥ kvacit||23||

nanda-gokula-vasinam — of the residents of Nanda's Gokula; bhaktih — the bhakti; eva — indeed; su-durlabha — most rare; bhavyate — is realised in the heart; shuddha-bhavaih — by those of pure heart; cha — and; labhyate — is attained; va — or; naraih — by men; kvachit — only rarely.

23The bhakti of the dwellers of Nanda's Gokula is the hardest of all to attain: only the pure in heart realise it, and among men it is attained but rarely.

Verse 24

तां भक्तिं त्वञ्च प्रीत्या हि स्त्रीबालादिभ्यः स्वेच्छया।
ददासि को भवांस्तत्र दातास्तीति वदाशु मे॥२४॥

tāṁ bhaktiṁ tvañca prītyā hi strībālādibhyaḥ svecchayā|
dadāsi ko bhavāṁstatra dātāstīti vadāśu me||24||

tam — that; bhaktim — bhakti; tvam — You; cha — and; pritya — with love; hi — indeed; stri-bala-adibhyah — to women, children and others; sva-ichchhaya — by Your own will; dadasi — give; kah — who; bhavan — (like) You; tatra — in this; data — giver; asti — is there; iti — thus; vada — tell; ashu — quickly; me — Me.

24Yet You, by Your own will and with love, give that bhakti to women, children and all the rest. Is there any giver like You in this? Tell Me at once!"

Verse 25

स प्राह प्रहसन्नाथ दाता हर्ता च रक्षिता।
प्रेमदः करुणस्तेषां त्वमेव सर्वप्रेरकः॥२५॥

sa prāha prahasannātha dātā hartā ca rakṣitā|
premadaḥ karuṇasteṣāṁ tvameva sarvaprerakaḥ||25||

sah — He; praha — said; prahasan — laughing; natha — O Lord; data — giver; harta — taker; cha — and; rakshita — protector; prema-dah — giver of prema; karunah — compassionate; tesham — to them; tvam eva — You alone; sarva-prerakah — the impeller of all.

25He laughed and replied, "Lord! It is You who give and take away, You who protect, You who bestow prema and are merciful to people — You alone, for You move all."

Verse 26

एकः सपार्षदो नित्यानन्दो विश्वम्भरोऽपरः।
स्वरूपाद्यैः सदा प्रेमपूर्णानन्दविग्रहौ॥२६॥

ekaḥ sapārṣado nityānando viśvambharo'paraḥ|
svarūpādyaiḥ sadā premapūrṇānandavigrahau||26||

ekah — the one; sa-parshadah — with associates; nityanandah — Nityananda; vishvambharah — Vishvambhara; aparah — the other; svarupa-adyaih — with Svarupa and others; sada — always; prema-purna-ananda-vigrahau — two forms of bliss full of prema.

26On the one side is Nityananda with His associates, on the other Vishvambhara with Svarupa and others: both are forms of bliss, ever full of prema.

Verse 27

गदाधरेण च समं सेव्यमानौ निरन्तरम्।
क्रीडतः स्वसुखं कृष्णकीर्तनप्रेमविह्वलौ॥२७॥

gadādhareṇa ca samaṁ sevyamānau nirantaram|
krīḍataḥ svasukhaṁ kṛṣṇakīrtanapremavihvalau||27||

gadadharena — with Gadadhara; cha — and; samam — together; sevyamanau — being served; nirantaram — constantly; kridatah — They play; sva-sukham — at Their pleasure; krishna-kirtana-prema-vihvalau — overwhelmed with prema in Krishna's kirtana.

27Together with Gadadhara, constantly attended, They sport in Their own bliss, overwhelmed with prema in Krishna's kirtana:

Verse 28

यशोदानन्दनः कृष्णः श्रीगोपीप्राणवल्लभः।
श्रीराधारमणो रामानुजो रासरसोत्सुकः॥२८॥

yaśodānandanaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śrīgopīprāṇavallabhaḥ|
śrīrādhāramaṇo rāmānujo rāsarasotsukaḥ||28||

yashoda-nandanah — Yashodanandana (son of Yashoda); krishnah — Krishna; shri-gopi-prana-vallabhah — beloved of the gopis, dear as their life; shri-radha-ramanah — delight of Sri Radha; rama-anujah — younger brother of Rama; rasa-rasa-utsukah — eager for the rasa of the rasa dance.

28"Yashodanandana, Krishna, Sri Gopi-prana-vallabha, Sri Radha-ramana, Ramanuja, Rasa-rasotsuka!

Verse 29

रोहिणीनन्दनः कृष्णो यज्ञो रामो बलो हरिः।
रेवतीप्राणनाथश्च रासकेलिमहोत्सवः॥२९॥

rohiṇīnandanaḥ kṛṣṇo yajño rāmo balo hariḥ|
revatīprāṇanāthaśca rāsakelimahotsavaḥ||29||

rohini-nandanah — Rohininandana (son of Rohini); krishnah — Krishna; yajnah — Yajna; ramah — Rama; balah — Bala; harih — Hari; revati-prana-nathah — lord of Revati's life; cha — and; rasa-keli-maha-utsavah — whose great festival is the play of the rasa dance.

29Rohininandana, Krishna, Yajna, Rama, Bala, Hari, Revati-prana-natha, Rasa-keli-mahotsava!"9

Verse 30

इति नाम प्रगायन्तौ भक्तवर्गसमन्वितौ।
श्रीकृष्णचैतन्यनित्यानन्दरामौ स्मरेत्तु तौ॥३०॥

iti nāma pragāyantau bhaktavargasamanvitau|
śrīkṛṣṇacaitanyanityānandarāmau smarettu tau||30||

iti — thus; nama — the names; pragayantau — singing; bhakta-varga-samanvitau — accompanied by the hosts of devotees; shri-krishna-chaitanya-nityananda-ramau — Sri Krishna Chaitanya and Nityananda-Rama; smaret — one should remember; tu — indeed; tau — the two.

30Thus They sing the names, surrounded by hosts of devotees. Let everyone remember Them — Sri Krishna Chaitanya and Nityananda-Rama.

Thus ends the twenty-fourth sarga, "The Pastimes in the Circle of Devotees" (Bhakta-mandala-vilasa), of the fourth prakrama of the poem "Sri Krishna-chaitanya-charitamrita."

✦

Notes

  1. Taking the sea for the Yamuna, the Lord threw Himself into it; Svarupa and other devotees searched for Him and found Him. These pastimes of the Lord's last years in Puri are told in detail in Krishnadasa Kaviraja's "Chaitanya-charitamrita" (Antya-lila, chs. 14–18).
  2. Krishna's form, voice, fragrance, the taste of His lips and His touch each draw one of the five senses — sight, hearing, smell, taste and touch.
  3. Chataka-parvata: a sand hill on the seashore near Puri.
  4. That is, with narration and songs of the rasa-lila, Krishna's dance with the gopis (cf. the next verse).
  5. Krishna Himself, Radha's beloved, in the form of Gaura takes on Her bhava in order to taste Her love for Him; He does not cease to be Krishna or "become" Radha, but is immersed in the bliss of Her mood.
  6. Paramananda: Paramananda Puri; Vasudeva: probably Vasudeva Datta; Govinda: the Lord's servant.
  7. Nityananda is Balarama, who grew up in Nanda's house together with Krishna.
  8. Cf. 4.23.13–15. The nine kinds of bhakti are hearing, chanting, remembering, serving the Lord's feet, worship, prayer, servitude, friendship and surrender of the self (Bhagavata Purana 7.5.23).
  9. Names of Krishna and Balarama: Yashodanandana, son of Yashoda; Gopi-prana-vallabha, beloved of the gopis, dear to them as life; Radha-ramana, delight of Radha; Ramanuja, younger brother of Rama; Rasa-rasotsuka, eager for the rasa of the rasa dance; Rohininandana, son of Rohini (Balarama); Revati-prana-natha, lord of the life of Revati, Balarama's consort; Rasa-keli-mahotsava, He whose great festival is the play of the rasa dance.
